title: Generate API Overview
description: Generates an API symbol index (api-index.json) from generated package docs.

docsDir.description: Root docs directory (relative to workspace root). Defaults to `.docs`.

outputDir.description: Output directory for api-index.json (relative to workspace root). Defaults to `.docs/public/api`.

packagePrefix.description: Prefix to filter package directories. ngpel project names carry no prefix, so leave it empty to include every package directory.
